title: lulynx Preview Cache Seam（预览缓存接缝）

standard.summary: 在训练时预览采样中使用 lulynx 缓存接缝工程路径跳过部分 DiT 完整计算。各后端仅是受相关研究启发的本地近似，不承诺对应论文的速度或质量结果。
standard.effect: sample_cache_seam_backend='none'（默认，不加速）。'spectrum' 使用本地线性外推探针；'smoothcache' 使用相邻 step 误差阈值；'deepcache' 与 'teacache' 使用本地层级缓存策略。
standard.whenToUse: 训练时预览采样太慢时。可以接受预览图轻微质量差异换取速度。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精确预览时。这些是 opt-in 探针，默认关闭不影响训练。

optionDescriptions.spectrum: lulynx 线性外推缓存：窗口越大，可能跳过越多但漂移风险越高。
optionDescriptions.smoothcache: lulynx 误差引导缓存：相邻 step 误差低于阈值才复用。

standard_en.summary: Uses the lulynx cache-seam engineering path in training-time preview sampling to skip part of the full DiT computation. Each backend is only a local approximation inspired by the related research and promises none of those papers' speed or quality results.
standard_en.effect: sample_cache_seam_backend='none' (the default, no acceleration). 'spectrum' uses a local linear-extrapolation probe; 'smoothcache' uses an error threshold between adjacent steps; 'deepcache' and 'teacache' use local layer-caching strategies.
standard_en.whenToUse: When training-time preview sampling is too slow. When you can accept a slight quality difference in the preview images in exchange for speed.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need an accurate preview. These are opt-in probes and, being off by default, do not affect training.

optionDescriptions.spectrum: The lulynx linear-extrapolation cache: the larger the window, the more can be skipped and the higher the drift risk.
optionDescriptions.smoothcache: The lulynx error-guided cache: it only reuses when the error between adjacent steps is below the threshold.

advanced.principle: DiT 推理中相邻 step 的输出特征可能相似；本地 Cache Seam 在满足条件时跳过完整 forward 并复用缓存。lulynx 线性外推使用 sample_spectrum_window_size，lulynx 误差缓存使用相邻 step relative-L1 与 sample_smoothcache_error_threshold。它们不是论文算法的逐项复现。
advanced.intervention: 采样循环中根据 backend 策略决定是否跳过当前 step 的完整计算。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能减少预览采样计算，但收益和漂移取决于模型与阈值；不使用未经本地 A/B 证实的论文速度/质量数字。
advanced.tradeoffs: sample_cache_seam_window_size 控制缓存窗口大小。smoothcache 和 spectrum 有各自的 warmup 控制。

advanced_en.principle: In DiT inference, outputs from adjacent steps can be similar; the local Cache Seam skips the full forward and reuses cache when conditions are met. The lulynx linear extrapolation uses sample_spectrum_window_size; the lulynx error cache uses adjacent-step relative-L1 with sample_smoothcache_error_threshold. These are not item-for-item reproductions of the paper algorithms.
advanced_en.intervention: In the sampling loop, the backend strategy decides whether to skip the current step's full computation.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May reduce preview sampling compute, but the benefit and drift depend on the model and thresholds; do not use paper speed/quality numbers without local A/B verification.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: sample_cache_seam_window_size controls the cache window size. smoothcache and spectrum each have their own warmup controls.
